title: SCHOLARLY_PROFILE_V1
description: Produced by scholarly-corpus-builder. A structured, evidence-backed profile of a discipline, journal, historical scholar, or author voice, built from a sampled corpus. Carries measured features, confidence, and limitations -- never raw private reasoning.

target.description: The discipline name, journal title/ISSN, scholar name, or author identifier profiled.

measured_features.description: Directly observed style/structure features (e.g. lexical, rhetorical, sectioning).

inferred_features.description: Features derived from measured_features via analysis; must be distinguishable from measured_features.

stability.description: Result of split-corpus stability testing, if performed.

biases.description: Known sampling or source biases (e.g. OA-only, single-decade window).
